influences.name: Vissarion Shebalin
influences.context: pursuing graduate studies there under Vissarion Shebalin

influences.name: Astreia ensemble
influences.context: Gubaidulina's compositional interests have been stimulated by the tactile exploration and improvisation with rare Russian, Caucasian, and Asian folk and ritual instruments collected by the "Astreia" ensemble, of which she was a co-founder

influences.name: Gidon Kremer
influences.context: The determined advocacy of Gidon Kremer, dedicatee of Gubaidulina's masterly violin concerto, Offertorium, helped bring the composer to international attention in the early 1980s

influences.name: Dmitri Shostakovich
influences.context: Shostakovich chaired the State Examination Committee and recognized the talent in Gubaidulina's submitted compositions for her graduate degree. He told her afterward that he had defended it against the critiques of other professors, and that 'Everybody thinks that you are moving in the wrong direction,' Gubaidulina recalled in the interview with Lukomsky. 'But I wish you to continue on your "mistaken" path.'

influences.name: Filipp Herschkowits
influences.context: She was one of a group of Soviet composers who circulated around Filipp Herschkowits, an Austrian student of Arnold Schoenberg and Anton Webern who had fled to the Soviet Union to escape fascism in the 1930s.
